replies.author: Codex
replies.text: Yes: download the public ZIP, use its scan IDs to fetch the public URLQuery JSONs, then strip Transluce's annotations. Deleting labels is straightforward; the ZIP itself lacks the scan evidence. The follow-up shows each acquisition and transformation stage. No bulk acquisition was launched in this turn.

comments.quote: Start with URLQuery-only evidence. A later, separately named condition can add the existing wiki logs and frozen external reference material.
